description: Source code for the NativeWindow11WinRT class managing Windows Runtime native window types, including initialization, client rect retrieval, swap chain creation, and validation of native window types.

classes.name: NativeWindow11WinRT
classes.description: Class managing Windows Runtime native window types for ANGLE on WinRT platforms.

methods.name: NativeWindow11WinRT
methods.description: Constructor initializing the native window with a handle and alpha transparency flag.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native window, determining its type and setting up the appropriate implementation.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: isIconic
methods.description: Checks if the window is minimized (always returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain for the window.

methods.name: commitChange
methods.description: Commits any pending changes to the window (empty implementation).

methods.name: IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Static method to validate if a window handle is a valid native window type.
